summary: Full e2e verification of admin CMS + UI/UX iteration. Backend: 25/25 pytest pass (auth, dashboard, GridFS upload/download, quote ref GF-YYYY-NNNN, admin quotes/contacts/FAQs/blog/case-studies/settings/subscribers CSV/campaigns queued+duplicate, subscribe silent-duplicate). Frontend: home, blog, case-studies, /quote 10-step wizard end-to-end (success with GF-2026-0002), footer subscribe, admin login → all 9 sidebar items, admin dashboard with seed data, admin FAQs render 8 seeded. Found and fixed CRITICAL bug on /faqs page (AccordionContent received both children prop and dangerouslySetInnerHTML, throwing 'Uncaught runtime error: Can only set one of children or props.dangerouslySetInnerHTML' which broke the whole page).

minor.issue: Oversize (>10MB) returns 413; spec said 400. Both are valid rejections; flagged for awareness only.
Returns 200 OK; REST convention would prefer 201 Created. Non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: <AccordionContent ... dangerouslySetInnerHTML={...} /> simultaneously gave children + innerHTML, crashing the whole page with React runtime error. Refactored to wrap inner <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML=...>. Verified — page now lists 8 FAQs.

action_items: (optional) Return 400 instead of 413 for oversize upload if you want to match the spec literally.
(optional) Return 201 from POST /api/quote and POST /api/contact per REST convention.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: 922 lines in a single file — should be split into routers (auth, admin/blog, admin/quote, admin/campaign, admin/faq, public) for maintainability.
server.py: SECURITY — /api/upload is unauthenticated. A bad actor could fill GridFS with 10MB files. Consider rate-limit or require captcha/quote-flow token.
server.py: admin_router endpoints are declared but the router needs to be included via app.include_router(admin_router) — verified present in startup; OK.
server.py: scheduler runs every 5 minutes; OK but no shutdown hook to cancel the task cleanly.

FAQs.jsx and any future admin-rendered HTML uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML — sanitize on save (server-side) to prevent stored XSS, since admin posts arbitrary HTML used in public /api/blog and /api/faqs.
GridFS download endpoint reads entire file into memory before returning. Switch to StreamingResponse for large files.

rca_of_the_issue:
FAQs page crash RCA: shadcn's AccordionContent component is defined as `({className, children, ...props}) =>
{children}
`. Passing dangerouslySetInnerHTML via ...props onto the outer Radix Content element, which already renders the inner
{children}
, triggers React's invariant: a DOM element cannot have both children and dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Fix: keep children semantic by rendering an inner
as the AccordionContent's child.
